payload.summary: Discovery complete: src/greeting.mjs contains a single export `greet` whose body is the template literal `` `Hello, ${name}!` `` — the greeting-string construction to extract into new src/format.mjs. Two configured validators are `.harness/project.yaml` `fixture-greeting` (node scripts/validate.mjs) and `contract-test` (node scripts/contract.mjs), both required and both asserting greet("AEH")==="Hello, AEH!" plus the greeting.mjs export surface. scripts/architecture.mjs already encodes the target end-state (greeting must import from exactly "./format.mjs"; format must not import "./greeting.mjs"; greeting exports must equal exactly ["greet"]) but is only a package.json script, not registered in project.yaml validation, and its format checks are conditional on src/format.mjs existing (absent today). No test/ specs/ evals/ trees; src/ holds only greeting.mjs; no external dependencies.

relevantFiles.reason: Refactor target: sole public export `greet`; greeting-string construction `` `Hello, ${name}!` `` (line 2) is the code to extract into src/format.mjs while keeping exactly one export named greet.

Configured validator `fixture-greeting` (project.yaml:272-275); statically imports { greet } from ../src/greeting.mjs (line 1) and asserts greet('AEH') === 'Hello, AEH!' (line 4). Must stay unchanged and keep passing.

Configured validator `contract-test` (project.yaml:277-281); static import of greet (line 1) plus behavior assertions (lines 4-5) and dynamic-import key allowlist ['greet','FAREWELL'] on greeting.mjs (lines 6-7). Must stay unchanged and keep passing.

Unconfigured but binding constraints for the refactor: requires greeting.mjs to match /from\s+["']\.\/format\.mjs["']/ and forbids format.mjs importing ./greeting.mjs (lines 11-15); enforces greeting export list == ["greet"] (lines 6, 9-10). `npm run check:architecture` (package.json:7).
Declares the two required configured validators (lines 269-281): node scripts/validate.mjs and node scripts/contract.mjs; these define deterministic acceptance and must not be modified.
test -> node scripts/validate.mjs; check:architecture -> node scripts/architecture.mjs (lines 5-8). No dependencies declared; entrypoints for local verification.
Authoring policy: pure no-behavior refactors should declare skip_specs: true rather than invent a behavioral delta (lines 7, 18, 22) — relevant to this internal-only refactor.

evidence: src/greeting.mjs:1-3 — `export function greet(name) { return \`Hello, ${name}!\`; }`
serena symbols overview src/greeting.mjs -> {Function: [greet]} (single symbol, single export)
findings.notes: The template literal on line 2 is the entire greeting-string construction; extraction leaves greet as a delegating wrapper, preserving the exact `export function greet` surface.

evidence: scripts/validate.mjs:1 — `import { greet } from "../src/greeting.mjs";`
scripts/contract.mjs:1 — same import; :6 dynamic `import("../src/greeting.mjs")`
grep `greet|Hello,` across repo -> 18 matches, all in src/greeting.mjs, scripts/{validate,contract,architecture}.mjs, .harness/project.yaml (validator id `fixture-greeting` only)
findings.notes: greet has exactly two consumers (validate.mjs, contract.mjs). Nothing imports greeting.mjs from src/, so no other call sites break.

.harness/project.yaml:276-281 — validators: - id: contract-test, adapter: contract-test, command: node scripts/contract.mjs, required: true

scripts/contract.mjs:4-7 — behavior assertions + `Object.keys(moduleValue).some(key => !["greet","FAREWELL"].includes(key))`

evidence: scripts/architecture.mjs:11 — `const format = read("src/format.mjs");`
